tasks.spec:
Your current working directory IS a git worktree of /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge (detached at HEAD). Edit files here directly. NEVER git commit, never touch /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge itself, never run `uv`, never call a billed model or the network. FIRST run: [ -e .venv ] || ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv .venv ; run tests as `PYTHONPATH=$PWD TMPDIR=/tmp .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider <tests>` (never pass --cov) and ruff as `.venv/bin/python -m ruff`. Never delete the .venv link. You own exactly four files: storygame/story_package/gap_rules.py, scripts/gap_rules.py, tests/test_gap_rules.py and docs/story-gap-guide.md. Do not edit anything else (plans and old Ringer manifests keep the old wording on purpose).

TASK: Brandon dislikes the word "flag" for what the layer 3 gap rules report: it suggests a stored marker that goes stale, but these are results computed fresh on every run. Rename the concept "flag" to "rule result" everywhere in the four files. This is a pure rename: no behavior, ordering, rule name, field or test logic changes. Do exactly this:
1. In storygame/story_package/gap_rules.py: class `Flag` becomes `RuleResult` (same dataclass fields: rule, anchor, subject, summary, evidence); `render_flags` becomes `render_rule_results`; helpers named `_custody_flags`, `_co_location_flags`, `_no_strand_flags`, `_no_producer_flags` become `_custody_results`, `_co_location_results`, `_no_strand_results`, `_no_producer_results`; local variables `flags` become `results` and `flag` becomes `result`; type hints `list[Flag]` become `list[RuleResult]`; docstrings and comments say "rule results" (for example "Load a package and report selected deterministic gap rule results.").
2. The rendered Markdown report changes wording: the title `# Gap flags: {anchor}` becomes `# Gap rule results: {anchor}`; the line `No flags.` becomes `No rule results.`; the sentence "Layer 3 story rules. Flags are reported, never block a build, and are not judgments; read the evidence." becomes "Layer 3 story rules. Rule results are reported, never block a build, and are not judgments; read the evidence." Keep everything else in the report byte-for-byte the same.
3. In scripts/gap_rules.py: import and call `render_rule_results`, rename local `flags` to `results`, and make the module docstring say "Print deterministic, read-only story gap rule results." Keep the exit codes and arguments unchanged.
4. In tests/test_gap_rules.py: use `RuleResult`/`render_rule_results`/`results`/`result` wherever the old names appear, and rename test functions and strings that contain "flag" so the word no longer appears (for example `test_custody_checks_include_every_flagged_pair` becomes `test_custody_checks_include_every_pair_with_a_result`, `test_single_reveal_strand_has_no_flags_for_every_transition` becomes `test_single_reveal_strand_has_no_results_for_every_transition`, `test_script_main_returns_zero_with_flags_and_two_for_unknown_anchor` becomes `test_script_main_returns_zero_with_results_and_two_for_unknown_anchor`). Update any assertion on the old report text (`Gap flags`, `No flags.`) to the new text. Do not weaken or delete any assertion.
5. In docs/story-gap-guide.md change the sentence "The rules print flags with evidence; flags are never errors and never block a build." to "The rules print rule results with evidence; rule results are never errors and never block a build." (keep the line wrapping style).
6. Run `grep -n -i flag storygame/story_package/gap_rules.py scripts/gap_rules.py tests/test_gap_rules.py docs/story-gap-guide.md`: it must print nothing.
7. Run the focused tests tests/test_gap_rules.py tests/test_situation_trace.py tests/test_branch_report.py tests/test_impact_report.py, then `.venv/bin/python -m ruff check storygame tests scripts/gap_rules.py` and `.venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check storygame tests scripts/gap_rules.py`. Fix what you broke.
Leave all changes uncommitted.
tasks.verified: The word flag is gone from the four owned files, the report text changed exactly as specified, the focused tests and ruff pass, and a patch of only those four files was exported.
